# rintup_contact_group (Resource)

A contact group: monitors alert it, and its channels (`rintup_alert_channel`) deliver the alert. Deleting the group deletes its channels.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rintup_contact_group" "ops" {
  name = "Ops on-call"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name (1-100 characters).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rintup_contact_group.ops 0192f3a4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-112233445566
```
